description: This header file declares functions and macros related to logging TLS keys in the cURL project, enabling logging of TLS session parameters for debugging or analysis.

methods.name: Curl_tls_keylog_open
methods.description: Opens the TLS key log file if requested by the user, based on environment variable or configuration.

methods.name: Curl_tls_keylog_close
methods.description: Closes the TLS key log file if it is open.

methods.name: Curl_tls_keylog_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the TLS key log file has been successfully enabled by the user.

methods.name: Curl_tls_keylog_write
methods.description: Appends a TLS key log entry with specified label, client random, and secret data.

methods.name: Curl_tls_keylog_write_line
methods.description: Writes a line to the TLS key log file, ensuring it ends with a line feed.
